messages:
jamie: Heads-up — started seeing a regression on prod GPU hosts. p99 token latency +8% and a few OOMs last 3h after A->B rollout. Suspect KV prefill workloads + fragmentation.

patti: Which jobs? logs?

jamie: Stacktrace attached, but quick numbers: before rollout mem_frag_ratio=0.18, after=0.42, active_kv_size +30%. OOMs came from workspace allocator failing to satisfy slab request.

rafi: Interesting. Any change in kernel selection/batch distribution? Could be larger decode windows pushing workspace type.

jamie: We triggered kernel fallback more often (matmul tiling change) per perf trace. But the biggest delta is KV prefill short-lived large prefixes that allocate many small slabs -> fragmentation.

song: Proposal: introduce "demotion" path: prefills above X tokens go to demote-pool that uses packed-slot allocator tuned for transient items. That pool will have coarser slab sizing and be evicted first.

patti: Love it. How to avoid hurting latency for decode-heavy flows?

rafi: Add per-request KV cap (e.g., 32k tokens) + soft demotion threshold. Also prefer buffer reuse: when prefill finishes, reuse slots for decode if token shapes compatible.

jamie: Quick config draft:
```
kv.demotion.threshold_tokens=8192
kv.demotion.pool_size_ratio=0.15
kv.per_request_cap=32768
kv.pack.slot_size=[256,1024,4096]
```

song: Also run a frag sim (we have simulator) with realistic seq-length histo. Increase coalescing on demote-pool: coalesce adjacent small slots into a super-slot on free.

patti: Do we need a runtime flag to toggle per-model kernel selection to avoid extra workspace blowup? Maybe fallback to "small-workspace" kernels for demote-pool.

jamie: Good call. We can wire kernel_selector to prefer compact kernels for demoted allocations.

deploy-bot: alert: prod-host-12 high_mem_frag detected 2109876480

claire: Rollout plan suggestion: stage A/B 10% traffic for 24h, collect metrics: p99 latency, OOM rate, mem_frag_ratio, average_kv_hits, eviction_rate. If OOMs drop and p99 within 3% -> increase.

rafi: Also add smoke test: run heavy prefill job in staging that previously triggered slab fail.

song: I can implement demotion + packer, will need ~2 days for prototype + 1 day to simulate.

patti: I'll own rollout and metrics dashboards.

jamie: Thanks. Owner mapping: song implement, rafi QA + smoke, patti rollout, claire sign-off. Let's run sim before enabling in prod. @song please post PR with simulation results.

song: noted. I'll push a branch and ping here. :rocket:
